rules.notes: DYZ project SQL files must declare purpose, touched tables, deploy policy, and risk before normal deployment can auto-discover or explicitly execute them.

entries.summary: Review assignment project scope field and audit withdraw-return permission.

entries.summary: Runtime menu and role-menu reconciliation.

entries.risk: Schema compatibility check for homepage config tables.

entries.summary: Workbench configuration diagnostics support.
entries.deployPolicy: Normal ProgramMigration deployment is allowed.

entries.summary: Fresh default workbench style preset.
entries.deployPolicy: Do not auto-run in normal deployment unless intentionally refreshing workbench style.

entries.summary: Lively sky workbench style preset.
entries.deployPolicy: Do not auto-run in normal deployment unless intentionally refreshing workbench style.

entries.deployPolicy: Do not auto-run in normal deployment unless intentionally refreshing workbench style.

entries.summary: Report progress menu and permission setup.
entries.deployPolicy: Normal ProgramMigration deployment is allowed.
entries.risk: Changes report progress navigation and grants.

entries.summary: Report rule tables and safe menu initialization.
entries.deployPolicy: Normal ProgramMigration deployment is allowed.
entries.risk: Creates report-rule tables and menu grants; does not update activity/category runtime config.

entries.summary: Rich detail fields for homepage content cards.
entries.deployPolicy: Normal ProgramMigration deployment is allowed.
entries.risk: Adds fields/default support for homepage cards.

entries.summary: Ops-admin role, login alias field, and first-create permission baseline.
entries.deployPolicy: Normal ProgramMigration deployment is allowed.
entries.risk: Creates the ops-admin baseline only for a newly created crehn_ops role and no longer overwrites existing manual grants.

entries.summary: Review assignment score visibility schema migration.
entries.deployPolicy: Run on local and Aliyun databases after backup and before publishing a backend that reads score_visibility_policy.
entries.risk: Adds the backend compatibility field without overwriting existing review assignments.

entries.summary: Review score visibility backfill, score adjustment permission, legacy ops read-only result access, and ops workbench runtime configuration.
entries.deployPolicy: Do not auto-run in normal deployment. Execute only after separate review and database backup.
entries.risk: Updates existing review_assignment rows and workbench layout; legacy ops grants are skipped after the B-2 configurable baseline marker exists. Requires the schema migration first.

entries.summary: Merge legacy activity_quota_rule rows into activity_report_rule, disable legacy quota rows, rename report-rule menu labels, and retire legacy quota menu grants.
entries.deployPolicy: Do not auto-run in normal deployment. Execute only after separate review and database backup.
entries.risk: Migrates and soft-deletes runtime quota configuration rows; review affected activities before production.

entries.summary: One-time B-2 crehn_ops baseline cloned from current crehn_admin grants and bound to crehn_admin as its menu-permission upper bound.
entries.deployPolicy: Normal ProgramMigration deployment is allowed after the standard confirmation and database backup.
entries.risk: The first effective run replaces existing crehn_ops grants with the crehn_admin baseline; a transaction and persistent marker prevent partial or repeated overwrites.

entries.summary: Required shared review score-sheet template table.
entries.deployPolicy: Run on local and Aliyun databases after backup and before publishing a backend that reads review_score_sheet_template.
entries.risk: Creates one additive template table only; it does not change review assignments, scores, or runtime template data.

entries.summary: Initial review score-sheet template menu, reviewer export permission, and explicit default grants.
entries.deployPolicy: Run only as a reviewed initial or focused ProgramMigration after backup and permission review; it is excluded from recurring automatic releases because duplicate-key updates restore its original root-menu defaults.
entries.risk: Adds template edit grants to crehn_admin, crehn_ops, and crehn_expert, and submitted-score export only to crehn_expert; a later reviewed hierarchy/access reconciliation is required for the final live menu policy.

entries.summary: Additive multi-template, default-template, and flexible footer configuration fields for review score sheets.
entries.deployPolicy: Run on local and Aliyun databases after backup before publishing the multi-template backend.
entries.risk: Adds nullable configuration fields and one lookup index only; existing templates, assignments, and scores are unchanged.

entries.summary: Name the legacy score-sheet template and mark it as default only when its tenant has no default template.
entries.deployPolicy: Normal ProgramMigration deployment is allowed after the M10.1 required schema migration and database backup.
entries.risk: Updates only legacy template metadata when blank; it does not change template content, review assignments, or scores.

entries.summary: Additive school whitelist and blacklist scope fields for audit and review assignments.
entries.deployPolicy: Run on local and Aliyun databases after backup before publishing the assignment-scope backend.
entries.risk: Adds four nullable or defaulted configuration columns only; existing assignments remain all-school and business data is unchanged.

entries.summary: Convert the unreachable nested audit-assignment route into an in-page permission entry and remove role-wide audit-scope bypass from personal auditors and project viewers.
entries.deployPolicy: Normal ProgramMigration deployment is allowed after the standard confirmation and database backup.
entries.risk: Personal auditors without an active audit_assignment will no longer see audit projects; crehn_admin and explicitly authorized management roles keep full scope.

entries.summary: Additive excluded-project scope for category-wide review assignments so individual project reviewers can be removed without disabling the whole category.
entries.deployPolicy: Run on local and Aliyun databases after backup before publishing project-level review assignment maintenance.
entries.risk: Adds one nullable configuration column only; existing review assignments and scores keep their current behavior.

entries.summary: Additive personal handwritten-signature library plus immutable signed score-sheet headers and score-item snapshots.
entries.deployPolicy: Run on local and Aliyun databases after backup and before publishing the signed score-sheet backend.
entries.risk: Creates only additive signature-library and snapshot tables plus indexes; it does not write existing score data. Active signature hashes and active score items are unique, preserving reuse and a future void-and-resign path.

entries.summary: Additive signed score-sheet withdrawal audit fields and management lookup index.
entries.deployPolicy: Run on local and Aliyun databases after backup and before publishing a backend that supports signed-score-sheet withdrawal.
entries.risk: Adds nullable withdrawal audit fields and one lookup index only; it does not alter existing signed snapshots, review scores, or active-score occupancy.

entries.summary: Initial signed score-sheet summary/my-history menus and explicit administrator/expert withdrawal grants.
entries.deployPolicy: Run only as a reviewed initial or focused ProgramMigration after backup and permission review; it is excluded from recurring automatic releases because duplicate-key updates restore its original root-menu defaults.
entries.risk: Adds or updates six signed-sheet menu permission rows. crehn_admin receives global management and withdrawal; crehn_expert receives only own-history/export and withdrawal; a later reviewed hierarchy reconciliation is required for the final live menu policy.

entries.summary: Additive activity/category scoped score discrepancy warning rules with selectable safe formulas, thresholds and display text.
entries.deployPolicy: Run on local and Aliyun databases after backup and before publishing a backend that reads score warning configuration.
entries.risk: Creates one additive configuration table only; existing assignments, scores, generated results and published results are unchanged until a result is regenerated.

entries.summary: Reviewer-management menu grouping, signed-score summary and privileged teacher-signature library controls with a shrinkable crehn_admin_signature role.
entries.deployPolicy: Run on local and Aliyun databases after backup and before publishing signature-library administration. The one-time child-role baseline preserves later manual reductions.
entries.risk: Adds signature library status audit fields, reorganizes existing management menu parents, grants new functions to crehn_admin, and creates a restricted default-tenant crehn_admin_signature role. It never changes score records, signed-sheet snapshots, or OSS objects.

entries.summary: Additive storage for a restricted score-discrepancy formula expression.
entries.deployPolicy: Run on local and Aliyun databases after backup and before publishing a backend that accepts custom score-warning expressions.
entries.risk: Adds one nullable formula expression column only; the backend still validates expressions against a fixed variable and operator allow-list.

entries.summary: Adds a dedicated score-summary export action under the existing reviewer-management menu.
entries.deployPolicy: Run as a local ProgramMigration after backup and permission review; crehn_ops is explicitly denied and crehn_admin_signature is not re-expanded after its baseline.
entries.risk: Adds one export permission to crehn_admin only and does not change score, signature, result, or role-scope data.

entries.summary: Allow template-configured optional reviewer signatures while retaining immutable signed and unsigned score-sheet submission modes.
entries.deployPolicy: Run on local and Aliyun databases after backup and before publishing a backend that accepts unsigned score-sheet submissions.
entries.risk: Makes only the three handwritten-signature snapshot columns nullable and adds a defaulted submission mode; active-score occupancy, withdrawal audit, and result locks are unchanged.

entries.summary: Reconcile the reviewer-management menu hierarchy and remove shared score-sheet template page/edit access from review experts.
entries.deployPolicy: Run on local and Aliyun databases after backup; users must sign out and back in to refresh their dynamic menus.
entries.risk: Moves only the score-sheet template and signed-sheet summary menus under reviewer management. Review experts retain hidden template-read permission for score submission, but lose the template page and all shared-template write actions.

entries.summary: Controlled finalizer that keeps the score-sheet template and signed-sheet summary under reviewer management after initialization migrations.
entries.deployPolicy: Run automatically on local and Aliyun databases after backup. It is transaction-bound, repeatable, and contains no role-access deletion; M11.3 remains the separate reviewed access-revocation migration.
entries.risk: Moves only menu 17930 and 17990 under 17960, preserves the signed-sheet summary name, and adds the parent directory to non-expert roles that already have either child page.

entries.summary: Controlled finalizer that keeps the complete administrator review-management menu tree present and nested under its directory.
entries.deployPolicy: Run automatically on local and Aliyun databases after backup. It is transaction-bound, repeatable, and contains no schema DDL or role-access deletion; M11.0 remains the separate reviewed schema and child-role baseline migration.
entries.risk: Creates or reconciles only the score summary, signed-sheet summary and signature-library menu records; moves the existing assignment, template and result pages under 17960; and grants these administrative entries only to crehn_admin.

entries.summary: Add a dedicated audit/review detail-display configuration permission with a one-time administrator-role baseline.
entries.deployPolicy: Run on local and Aliyun databases only after backup and explicit ProgramMigration approval; users must sign out and back in to refresh permission menus.
entries.risk: Initially grants the new display-only configuration permission to crehn_admin, crehn_ops and crehn_admin_signature. A persistent baseline marker prevents later role-management reductions from being restored by a controlled replay.

entries.summary: Additive persisted project-tag filter JSON for server-enforced review assignment scopes.
entries.deployPolicy: Run on local and Aliyun databases after backup before publishing a backend that reads project_filter_json.
entries.risk: Adds one nullable configuration column only; existing assignments have no filter and retain their current project scope and score history.

entries.summary: Rename the reviewer task menu from My Review to Review Workbench without changing its route or permission.
entries.deployPolicy: Run automatically on local and Aliyun databases after backup. It is transaction-bound, repeatable, and changes no route, permission, or role grant.
entries.risk: Updates only menu_id 17920/17921 when their existing route, parent and permission markers match; no role grants or review data are changed.

entries.summary: Backfill missing project-upload overview workbench layouts for eligible active roles.
entries.deployPolicy: Run automatically on local and Aliyun databases after backup. It is transaction-bound, repeatable, and inserts only missing default layouts.
entries.risk: Creates only missing project_upload_overview defaults for active eligible roles; existing layouts and manually customized runtime configuration are not updated.

entries.summary: Bind crehn_ops to crehn_admin as its menu-permission upper bound and remove only grants outside that bound.
entries.deployPolicy: Normal ProgramMigration deployment is allowed after the required permission-scope schema migration and standard database backup.
entries.risk: Can only shrink crehn_ops grants that crehn_admin no longer has; it never copies newly added crehn_admin grants into crehn_ops.

entries.summary: Required additive sys_user login_alias column and unique index for the deployed authentication code.
entries.deployPolicy: Run on local and Aliyun databases after backup and before publishing a backend that queries login_alias.
entries.risk: Adds a nullable column and unique index only; contains no account, role, menu, permission, configuration, or business-data writes.

entries.summary: Required additive role menu-permission upper-bound column and lookup index.
entries.deployPolicy: Run on local and Aliyun databases after backup and before publishing a backend that reads permission_scope_role_id.
entries.risk: Adds one nullable role reference field and index only; it does not change any role grant or business data.

entries.summary: Required additive role-level browser close warning switch.
entries.deployPolicy: Run on local and Aliyun databases after backup and before publishing a backend that reads close_warning_enabled.
entries.risk: Adds one boolean-compatible field with an enabled default; it does not overwrite role grants, account assignments, or business data.

entries.summary: Runtime templates, notice templates, upload rules, school field schema, and workbench config defaults.
entries.deployPolicy: Do not auto-run in normal deployment. Execute only when intentionally refreshing runtime templates/config.
entries.risk: Can change production runtime templates and prompts.

entries.summary: Default activity/category submission templates and file requirements.
entries.deployPolicy: Do not auto-run in normal deployment. Execute only after template review and database backup.
entries.risk: Deletes/rebuilds template category rows in configured ID ranges and can affect runtime submission templates.

entries.summary: Upload validation rule/template adjustments.
entries.deployPolicy: Do not auto-run in normal deployment. Execute only when intentionally changing upload validation templates.
entries.risk: Updates runtime upload validation templates.

entries.summary: Showcase standard upload template.
entries.deployPolicy: Do not auto-run in normal deployment unless template refresh is intended.
entries.risk: Adds runtime upload template data.

entries.summary: Home/workbench stage notice text updates.
entries.deployPolicy: Do not auto-run in normal deployment unless notice template refresh is intended.
entries.risk: Updates runtime notice template text.

entries.summary: Activity category option and file requirement template additions; legacy quota seeds are retired.
entries.deployPolicy: Do not auto-run in normal deployment. Execute only after runtime activity/template review.
entries.risk: Can add/update activity category templates and quota rule defaults.

entries.summary: Activity display-name cleanup.
entries.deployPolicy: Do not auto-run in normal deployment unless activity naming migration is intended.
entries.risk: Updates runtime activity rows.

entries.summary: Project recycle fields, audit assignment table, menus, and sample audit assignment row.
entries.deployPolicy: Do not auto-run in normal deployment because it can insert runtime audit assignment data.
entries.risk: May create sample audit_assignment rows for fixed users/activity if they exist.

entries.summary: Chinese file review message backfill.
entries.deployPolicy: Do not auto-run in normal deployment. Execute only as an intentional data backfill.
entries.risk: Updates existing project and file review message data.

entries.summary: Full runtime activity/category/template snapshot; legacy quota dump is retired.
entries.deployPolicy: Never auto-run in normal deployment. Use only for deliberate restore/reseed after review.
entries.risk: Deletes and reinserts runtime activity configuration; can overwrite production operation data.

entries.summary: Test accounts, test activity, test school/project data.
entries.deployPolicy: Never run in production or normal deployment.
entries.risk: Creates test data and can pollute production.

entries.summary: Core crehn tables and base fields for new database setup.
entries.deployPolicy: New-server or empty-database initialization only.
entries.risk: Creates base schema; not a normal update path.

entries.summary: Initial crehn menu tree and grants.
entries.deployPolicy: New-server initialization only.
entries.risk: Can reset/duplicate initial menu assumptions if misused.

entries.summary: Initial configuration menu for crehn setup.
entries.deployPolicy: New-server initialization only.
entries.risk: Can change initial menu assumptions if misused.

entries.summary: RuoYi-Vue-Plus base database initialization.
entries.deployPolicy: Framework/new-server initialization only.
entries.risk: Do not run against an existing business database as a normal update.

entries.summary: RuoYi job module base initialization.
entries.deployPolicy: Framework/new-server initialization only.
entries.risk: Do not run against an existing business database as a normal update.

entries.summary: Add stable role_key ownership for workbench layouts, copy role-shell configuration to stable keys, and complete the result-admin and audit-supervisor roles.
entries.deployPolicy: Manual database migration only after backup, orphan-layout readback, and explicit SQL authorization; never auto-apply during application deployment.
entries.risk: Adds indexes and roles, backfills layout ownership, and copies role-shell configuration. The NOT NULL conversion intentionally blocks on orphan layouts; numeric shell keys remain for old-version rollback.

entries.summary: RuoYi workflow module base initialization.
entries.deployPolicy: Framework/new-server initialization only.
entries.risk: Do not run against an existing business database as a normal update.
